views.label: Pay path
views.note: From provider-signed terms to payment after expiry.

views.label: Pay or burn
views.note: The owner settles within SettlementTimeout; after that the provider claims.

views.label: Before expiry
views.note: A refunded agreement runs to expiry unpaid and the provider stays liable. A replacement (virtual providers only) is the one early end.

views.label: Slashed provider
views.note: remove_slashed ends a live agreement of a physical provider slashed below its stake snapshot; the owner gets the payment back.

transitions.label: runs to expiry, nothing to pay

cards.title: While active
items: extend_agreement (owner only): pays the elapsed period, locks payment for additional_duration at the current price, re-snapshots stake; needs expected_version and stake >= MinProviderStake; fails once expired
top_up_agreement (owner only) buys more max_bytes for the remaining duration; needs expected_version
Both are rejected while a replacement is pending; set_extensions_blocked lets the provider reject extensions and replacements for one agreement
transfer_agreement_ownership moves the escrow hold to the new owner; bucket membership stays
Open challenges block nothing here: settlement, burn, refund, extension and replacement activation proceed while one is open

cards.title: Pay or burn
items: EndAction::Burn burns the locked payment and charges the owner BurnPremium; without the funds the burn fails
After SettlementTimeout the provider calls claim_expired_agreement and the owner loses the burn option

cards.title: Early exits
items: Binding commitment: no early end by the owner or the provider; the only early end is a replacement (virtual providers only)

refund_agreement (provider only) returns the remaining payment to the owner at any time before settlement; the agreement runs on unpaid and the provider stays liable. Replaces the burn as the provider-side exit
Replacement activation settles the old agreement as an extension would: elapsed period paid, remainder moved into the successor's escrow
remove_slashed (anyone, physical providers only): valid while the agreement is live and a slash left locked_stake below its stake snapshot; the remaining payment returns to the owner

cards.title: After the last agreement
items: A provider offboards by not accepting new agreements or extensions and letting the existing ones expire
deregister_provider is one step once committed_bytes is 0 and no challenge is open: no announcement window, stake released, Providers entry removed
